capabilities.positive_probe_design: Create one synthetic non-production brief and register it with an explicit correlation_id.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Missing brief, duplicate run identity, invalid correlation_id and wrong formal runtime env must be rejected.
capabilities.blocking_edge: needs shared capability receipt schema and non-production coordinator probe

capabilities.positive_probe_design: Advance the synthetic run through a local/sandbox transport and capture candidate/review hashes.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Wrong lane, unknown exact run id, invalid JSON, stale job identity and missing runtime token must block.
capabilities.blocking_edge: needs non-production runner transport authorization or deterministic local fixture boundary

capabilities.positive_probe_design: Select exactly the synthetic completed run id.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Empty, duplicate, unknown or wrongly formatted run ids must block.

capabilities.positive_probe_design: Dry-run publish for synthetic completed run without production mutation.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Policy rejection, missing candidate/review, wrong runtime identity and sandbox escape must block.

capabilities.positive_probe_design: Create and remove sandbox transaction worktree through injected dry-run git.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Dirty actor, runtime digest drift, non-canonical sandbox and overlapping queue/state roots must block.
capabilities.blocking_edge: depends on publisher runtime identity receipt

capabilities.positive_probe_design: Injected dry-run stage/commit/tag with version 0.0.0 inside sandbox.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Invalid version, missing staged files or runtime drift must block.

output_artifacts: atomic push result or unresolved push control record
capabilities.positive_probe_design: Sandbox preflight only in this phase; production push requires later explicit authorization.
capabilities.fail_closed_probe_design: Push mode mismatch, unresolved push control, remote divergence and push outcome inconsistency must block.
capabilities.blocking_edge: depends on production authorization after readiness and capacity PASS
